text: the body is 'getting used to' the movement patterns required for exercise performance. A general motor program must be created and then finetuned to carry out the exercise in a coordinated fashion. Ultimately, this results in a smoother, more efficient motor pattern and thus allows greater force to be exerted during the movement.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
chapter: Chapter 1: Hypertrophy-Related Responses and Adaptations to Exercise Stress
